findings.text: follow-on: the run's gate-log headers spell the revision as rev=<sha>, which the review reader recognises only as 'revision ...', so base_log_revision and head_log_revision are null for both declared arms even though each header does name its revision (baseline_lowstate_render.log rev=68762d36; after_lowstate_render.log rev=11541380). Separately, the auxiliary head-tree logs logs/gate_scan.log (the exit-0 head scanner gate) and logs/after_suite.log (the six-file head run) carry rev=68762d3639 (base) while their tree= fields name the head worktree; base content cannot exit 0, so those header revs are wrong. The declared arms are correctly labelled and the added-failure derivation is sound, so this is a traceability defect in the log headers, not the count.

follow-on: no committed test pins the six repaired drivers. tests/test_renderer_wall_scan.py states it asserts no total count and its expectations are control sites in other files, so removing any wall= from the six drivers would not redden the suite; I showed the scanner itself detects such a removal (site exact_support_floor_attribution.py:724 re-reported, EXIT=1), so the guard exists but is manual-only.

follow-on: the commit carries unrelated ruff-format collapses in two touched files (_problem and _figure_title in exact_clip_seed_amplitude.py, _build_context in fixture_positional_stiffness.py) that are not part of the wall-mask change and widen the diff.

justifications.durability: The fix is real and pinned by a falsifiable source scan whose two arms I reproduced, and I showed the scanner is live by removing one wall=units from head content and watching it re-report the site (exact_support_floor_attribution.py:724, EXIT=1, review-mutation-head.log). Weakness: no committed assertion pins the six repaired drivers - tests/test_renderer_wall_scan.py states it asserts no total count and checks only control sites in other files, so removing a wall= from any repaired driver would not redden the suite; the regression guard is a manual scanner run only.
justifications.evidence: Every headline reproduces first-hand: base arm 18 sites EXIT=1, head arm 0 sites EXIT=0; the negative control is the base arm of the same command listing exactly the 18 named sites, matching the manifest line-for-line; the focused suite arm tests/test_exact_clip_low_state_render.py fails the same 3 pre-existing ids at base and head (my worktree and reviewed worktree, EXIT=1 both), so the after-minus-base set difference is empty. Weakness: the auxiliary head-tree logs logs/gate_scan.log and logs/after_suite.log carry rev=68762d36 (base) in their header while tree= names the head worktree, so those headers do not tie to a commit.
justifications.fit: Minimal and idiomatic: each of the 18 edits adds one wall keyword to an existing draw_flux_contours call, handed the wall the driver already loads (wall=/wall_units=/units are bound in each enclosing scope, verified), and accepts the tuple spelling through the painter's optional wall; no new helper, dependency or signature change. Minor: the commit also carries unrelated ruff-format collapses in exact_clip_seed_amplitude.py (_problem, _figure_title) and fixture_positional_stiffness.py (_build_context), widening the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Goal fully met and independently reproduced: the scanner tests/renderer_wall_scan.py over the six drivers reports 18 unguarded draw_flux_contours calls at base content (68762d36, EXIT=1) and none at the reviewed head 11541380 (EXIT=0), logs review-scan-base.log/review-scan-head.log; all 18 calls now carry a wall keyword, and nova.media.poloidal.draw_flux_contours blanks every grid point outside the wall to NaN before contouring (poloidal.py:167-173), so the mask demonstrably fires.
justifications.scope_discipline: The commit touches exactly the six granted benchmark drivers and the granted evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/figure-and-solver-audit/fsa-wall-mask-exact-and-centroid.html; no source under nova/, no test file, no plan file, no shared index and no concurrent-node path is edited; the single commit 11541380 carries a conventional subject and an explanatory body, no AI-attribution trailer and no plan/ticket/stage identifier in names or comments.
